owner: DelegatedCheckoutApi over the existing native START source and original-command journal
authentication: Existing opaque customer bearer and current native resource/customer/contact proof before input collection, repeated after collection by native owners; exact loopback host and origin checks. This is not provider or remote sender authentication.
input_policy: Strict UTF-8 JSON without duplicate members or malformed Unicode; exact fields and original lowercase non-nil command UUID. No caller grant, correlation, provider result, proof, authority flags, URL, trust or context provisioning.
configuration: Server-only descriptor-checked owners and command container. Fixed correlation constructs one existing C2 owner. Missing command configuration is unavailable; correlation without a concrete source preserves history/recovery/cancel. START requires the configured actual C3 owner and complete native currentness.

response.result: Unchanged C2 historical_unverified_observation view or unsent recovery projection, from local_unverified_input with provider_authenticated:false and receipt_signature_verified:false; no new current-authority claim

start: C3 constructs the complete original from an actual owner preview and retains it in C2's top-level transaction. Same-ID changed intent conflicts. No outer transaction, replacement UUID, send decision or business effect is added.
recovery: Construct the exact unsent RECOVER_RESULT from retained original intent. Only command_id is accepted; the expected digest comes from C2. It does not contact a provider or refresh authority, and retains C2's recovery/migration egress fence.
history: Original read and revision-bound cancellation retain current-proof native access without needing live preview or receipt provenance. Cancelled exact repeats stay masked history; minimized content is not restored. Absence or a lost response cannot authorize replacement or automatic retry.
errors: Finite command codes map deliberately; cross-subject absence maps to NOT_FOUND. Arbitrary exception text is never returned or logged.
privacy: No-store responses and code-only logs. No new persistent surface, raw receipt, proof, credential or personal projection. Existing C2/C3 privacy, hold, original-subject held-erasure, restore and import semantics remain authoritative.
client: Five explicit command-* subcommands in the existing independent Python caller; literal loopback only, bounded strict response parsing, original UUID and digest/canonical binding checks, all authority flags false, private bearer environment input, no automatic retry or UUID generation.
compatibility: The original seven-route checkout contract and separate preparation-recovery contract remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
unsupported: provider authentication or current grant authority
